scope: Supplement to frozen source-label codebook; actual transformations and unresolved upstream definitions
source: Corrected McIntosh-Zeitlin deposit 10.5281/zenodo.15881329; household_panel.dta, individual_panel.dta, CostsAndCompliance.xlsx and CovariateLists.xlsx

identifiers.hhid: Arbitrary sequential household key, common to core and supplementary extracts
identifiers.vid: Arbitrary sequential village key, assignment and clustering unit
identifiers.childid: Arbitrary sequential original roster key; no source roster identifiers exported

round: 1 baseline Aug-Sep 2016; 2 endline Sep-Oct 2017; exact dates not exported
eligible: Source IPA-defined baseline eligibility, fixed across household rounds; no receipt-based selection
samp_wgt: Source sampling expansion weight. At eligible baseline equals nEligible divided by released sampled eligible village count, within 4.77e-7. Frozen across rounds. samplingprobability is its reciprocal within source float precision. Source paper mentions intensive tracking, but no separate recoverable tracking factor is inferred from these identities.
assignment_probability: Village count assigned to arm in block divided by block village count. Distinct from samplingprobability; generated separately, all 132 cells published.
sample_panel: Source household present both rounds; selects original ANCOVA endline analysis, not full-baseline endpoint bounds
dietarydiversity: Frozen initial reconstruction: sum of 12 combined food groups; missing unless all 16 raw category responses are binary. Complete modules exactly agree with source. No winsorization or replacement applied by this project.
diet_source: Unmodified source score, including seven noninteger endline replacements around 4.46263. Underlying replacement mechanism not reconstructed from upstream survey cleaning.
diet_interval: Revision uses observed positive subcategory to establish any-combined group; all observed zeros establish zero; otherwise unknown. Sum certain positives and possible positives gives [lower,upper]; absent response [0,12]. Two additional eligible diets become identified. All baseline eligible households retained for bounds.
m9_categories: Binary household 24-hour recall categories; 888, 999, other nonbinary values and NaN treated unknown, never zero. Vegetables (3), fruits (2), meat (2) combined with any-positive rule. Cereals, tubers, eggs, fish, legumes, milk, oils, sweets and spices each single group. Not child nutrient measurement.
foodexpenditure: Source-labeled weekly-recall purchased food expenditure; supplied monetary field retained. Revision shows asinh(source value), including zeros. Monetary price base/deflation not established from field label; no USD or percentage interpretation asserted.
foodownconsumption: Source-labeled weekly-recall value of own-produced food consumption; same units/preprocessing caveat as foodexpenditure. Project asinh retains zeros; negative or missing values are not silently recoded.
source_economic_IHS: consumption_asinh, productiveassets_asinh, savingsstock_asinh and borrowingstock_asinh are inherited source transformations. Underlying currency scale, upstream winsorization and source replacement are not reconstructed by this package. Effects are changes in supplied transformed units, not percentage changes.
source_indices: health_knowledge and sanitation_practices retain source indices and their source normalization; no new index estimation. The original article describes source construction. Unit is one source index unit.
baseline_controls: Initial ANCOVA maps observed round-1 values by household; missing controls replaced by weighted block mean with missing flag (global fallback only no observed value in a block). No outcome imputation. Crosswalk instead retains source preconstructed lag and selected controls as explicitly labeled.
revision_households: 5506 household-round rows; includes baseline village frame counts/probability and fixed original diet controls. Frame counts missing at endline are not imputed; baseline used. Source L-prefixed columns and R1 fields inherit source lag/replacement/construction. Covariate list frozen from original workbook, no LASSO rerun.
children: 7356 child-round records selected if any source anthro_shouldbe, anthro_baseline or anthro_present is one. Scientific regression uses endline, baseline-eligible households and anthro_shouldbe=1, with finite outcome. Source standardized haz06, waz06, muacz and supplied baseline versions retained; source upstream anthropometric cleaning not reconstructed. No newborn-specific selection, dates, names, geography or administrative identifiers exported.
child_inference: Exploratory baseline-score ANCOVA with block indicators, household sampling weights and village clustering; distinct from parent paper's richer age/sex/LASSO controls and optional attrition IPW. Fifteen Holm tests; outcome-specific N. Source anthropometric selection may remain treatment dependent.
costs: Study-period US dollars per beneficiary, eligible household or whole-population household as labeled. costs.csv preserves provider cost_beneficiary, share_averted, compliance_eligibles, cost_eligible, compliance_population, cost_population. Primary budget uses eligible cost. Cost scenarios are hypothetical fixed-effect accounting, not cost confidence intervals or take-up causal forecasts.
immutability: input-reference.json pins three original bytes at public commit 046ce79. revision-reference.json pins two additional extracts and source-member hashes. Both are checked before master estimation; generated provenance alone is not authoritative. Source extraction verifies reference before replacing analytical bytes. Tamper tests run on isolated fixtures.
rights: Derived numeric research data CC BY 4.0 with attribution and transformation disclosure. Original corrected deposit rights recorded in docs/sources/zenodo-rights.json. No claim of replication of restricted originals or upstream survey cleaning.
